title: Offer
description: One provider x TLD price record (data/offers/<provider>/<tld>.json). All amounts are integer minor units (cents) of `currency`. See docs/concepts/tldcost.md section 3.2.

schema_version.description: 2 since Archiv-Issue 124: the yes/no feature fields may also be "paid", and feature_costs is new. provider and fx records stay at 1.

tld.description: TLD without leading dot, lower case (punycode for IDN TLDs).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of all amounts in `price`.

vat_included.description: true: amounts are gross. false: amounts are net, gross is computed with `vat_rate` (offer) or the provider's `vat_rate`. null: the provider (outside the EU only, checked by validate-data) makes no VAT statement; the price is used as stated in gross and net mode and flagged with a footnote.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in basis points (1900 = 19 %). Overrides the provider's rate for this offer.

unit.description: Billing unit of the recurring amounts (year1, year1_regular, renewal, year2, year3). `month` amounts are multiplied by 12 and require 1-year terms. setup and transfer amounts are always one-off.

year1.description: Payment for the first term: actual price incl. a public promo (with stated period or conditions), never a coupon code.

year1_regular.description: List price of year 1 without promo.

renewal.description: Payment for every renewal term, unless year2/year3 differ.

term_years.description: Years covered by the year1 payment (TLDs only registrable for several years). Default 1. Every payment due within N years counts in full, no pro-rating.

renewal_term_years.description: Years covered by each renewal payment. Default 1.

transfer_in.description: One-off payment to move an existing domain in.

transfer_includes_term.description: true only if the provider states that the transfer includes a term (one renewal term, e.g. one year); the statement goes in transfer_includes_term_source. false, null or missing: the transfer includes no term, the renewal price is due from year 1 as well (methodik). Used by the transfer mode of the portfolio calculator only.

transfer_includes_term_source.description: Where the provider states that the transfer includes a term: the page URL and/or the verbatim quote. Required when transfer_includes_term is true (validate-data).

icann_fee_included.description: gTLD only; null = unknown or not applicable.

max_per_customer.description: Most domains per customer at the promo price, as stated by the provider (source in max_per_customer_source); limit_scope says whether per TLD or across all TLDs of the provider. null or missing (or limit_scope not stated): the portfolio calculator counts ONE promo domain per provider in total.

max_per_customer_source.description: Where the provider states the limit: the page URL and/or the verbatim quote. Required when max_per_customer is a number (validate-data).

limit_scope.description: Where max_per_customer applies: per_tld (per TLD) or per_customer (across all TLDs of the provider). unlimited: the provider states no limit per customer for this TLD; needs the verbatim quote in max_per_customer_source and max_per_customer null (validate-data); the portfolio calculator then gives every domain of the TLD the promo, outside the per-customer pool. null or missing: not stated; the calculator counts ONE promo domain per provider in total.

promo.description: Public promo already applied to year1. Only promos active at evidence.fetched_at are recorded; coupon codes never.

whois_privacy.description: free/paid: offered at no charge or for a fee (for paid: source and price in feature_costs.whois_privacy); none: the provider does not offer it; n/a: not possible for this TLD (e.g. .de); null: unknown.

feature_costs.description: Since schema_version 2. Per feature whose value is "paid": where the provider states it (URL and verbatim quote, required) and, only where the source names them, the price, its unit and a short note. An entry only for a field whose value is "paid" (validate-data).

source_url.description: Public, human-readable provider page with the price (required, linked in the table).

source_endpoint.description: The URL actually fetched when it differs from source_url (method api, JSON). evidence_hash is over its response body.

evidence_hash.description: sha256 of the fetched response body (source_endpoint if set, else source_url).

amount.description: Integer minor units (cents) of `currency`; null = unknown.

featureValue.description: true: included. "paid" (since schema_version 2): offered only for a fee; source in feature_costs. false: not offered. null: unknown.

source.description: Where the provider states the fee: page URL, the verbatim quote and its language (lang, default de).

lang.description: Language of the quote; missing = de. The site marks a quote in another language than the page with lang.

price_cents.description: Price as the source names it: integer minor units of the offer's `currency`, in the offer's VAT mode (vat_included). Only with unit.

unit.description: Billing unit of price_cents: per year, per month or once.

note.description: Short German note, e.g. bundle, first-year price, "je Hosted Zone".
